whatIs: CTA.gallery is a gallery of calls to action from real sites. You filter by industry and mode, and by eight categories: button, purchase, download, form, modal or pop-up, navigation, newsletter and pricing or subscription.
It's a good fit when you already have the page built and need to decide how to design the element that converts, without starting from scratch.
uses: Comparing how several products present their pricing section before designing yours.
Choosing the style of a subscription or newsletter form for a landing page.
Reviewing examples of modals and pop-ups so yours doesn't come across as intrusive.
caveats: It shows the visual result of each CTA, not its code or conversion data.
Examples load in batches with Load More, so going through a whole category takes several clicks.
It includes sponsored links to templates alongside the examples.
pricingNote: Free to browse; the site offers advertising and example submissions.
idealFor: Anyone designing landing pages who wants conversion-focused inspiration.
